lesson.title: 理解对数

en.title: Understanding Logarithms
en.description: A social network can model user count as an exponential function of time. Predicting the time needed to reach a given user count uses the inverse function. Understand logarithms as exponents, graph inverses, evaluate exact and estimated values, and interpret logarithmic models.

lesson.description: 社交网站的用户数可用时间的指数函数模拟；反过来预测达到给定人数所需的时间，需要指数函数的反函数。本节把对数理解为指数，画反函数图，计算精确值与估计值，并解释对数模型。

concepts.title: 对数是指数
concepts.summary: $\log_c x=y\Leftrightarrow c^y=x$，其中 $c>0$、$c\ne1$、$x>0$。省略底数的 $\log x$ 是常用对数，底数为 $10$。

method.title: 识别三个量
method.body: 底数保持为底数；对数值是指数；真数是幂的结果。

method.title: 转换形式
method.body: 把 $\log_c x=y$ 写成 $c^y=x$；反向转换同理。

pitfalls: 真数必须严格大于零；底数不能是零、负数或 1。

en.title: A logarithm is an exponent
en.summary: $\log_c x=y\Leftrightarrow c^y=x$, where $c>0$, $c\ne1$, and $x>0$. A common logarithm, $\log x$, has base $10$.

method.title: Identify the three quantities
method.body: Keep the same base; the logarithm is the exponent, and the argument is the resulting power.

method.title: Convert forms
method.body: Write $\log_c x=y$ as $c^y=x$, or reverse this conversion.

pitfalls: The argument must be strictly positive; the base cannot be zero, negative, or one.

concepts.title: 用幂与逆运算求精确值

method.title: 读出指数
method.body: 若 $c^t=x$，则 $\log_cx=t$。嵌套对数从最里面开始。

pitfalls: 不要把对数的底数与真数交换；每层对数的输入均须为正。

en.title: Exact values and inverse properties
en.summary: Express the argument as a power of the base. $\log_c1=0$, $\log_cc=1$, $\log_c(c^t)=t$, and $c^{\log_cx}=x$ for $x>0$.

method.title: Read the exponent
method.body: If $c^t=x$, then $\log_cx=t$. Evaluate nested logarithms from the inside outward.

pitfalls: Do not interchange base and argument; each nested logarithm must receive a positive input.

concepts.title: 求未知真数或底数
concepts.summary: 先转为指数形式，再解方程。若未知量是底数，必须检查 $c>0$、$c\ne1$。

method.title: 转换与求解
method.body: $\log_c x=t\Rightarrow x=c^t$；$\log_x a=t\Rightarrow x^t=a$。

method.title: 代回检查
method.body: 把候选值代回原对数，检查正真数、合法底数及原式等式。

pitfalls: 平方方程可能给出负根，负数不能作为实对数的底数。

en.title: Determine an unknown argument or base
en.summary: Convert to exponential form and solve. If the unknown is a base, enforce $c>0$ and $c\ne1$.

method.title: Convert and solve
method.body: $\log_c x=t\Rightarrow x=c^t$; $\log_x a=t\Rightarrow x^t=a$.

method.title: Check in the original logarithm
method.body: Substitute candidates into the original logarithm and check positive arguments, legal bases, and equality.

pitfalls: A squared equation may produce a negative root, which cannot be a real logarithm base.

concepts.title: 指数与对数的反函数图像
concepts.summary: $y=c^x$ 与 $y=\log_cx$ 关于 $y=x$ 对称。对数定义域 $(0,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$，截点 $(1,0)$，竖直渐近线 $x=0$。

method.title: 交换坐标
method.body: 点 $(a,b)$ 在原函数上，则 $(b,a)$ 在反函数上。用精确点画平滑曲线。

method.title: 交换特征
method.body: 定义域与值域、横轴截点与纵轴截点、水平与竖直渐近线分别交换。

method.title: 判断增减
method.body: $c>1$ 时二者递增；$0<c<1$ 时二者递减。

pitfalls: 反函数的横轴变量与原函数的横轴变量意义不同。$f^{-1}$ 不是 $1/f$。

en.title: Graphs of exponential and logarithmic inverses
en.summary: $y=c^x$ and $y=\log_cx$ reflect in $y=x$. The logarithm has domain $(0,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, intercept $(1,0)$, and vertical asymptote $x=0$.

method.title: Swap coordinates
method.body: If $(a,b)$ lies on the original graph, $(b,a)$ lies on its inverse. Plot exact points and join smoothly.

method.title: Swap characteristics
method.body: Domain and range, x- and y-intercepts, and horizontal and vertical asymptotes exchange roles.

method.title: Determine direction
method.body: Both are increasing for $c>1$ and decreasing for $0<c<1$.

pitfalls: The inverse input has a different meaning from the original input. $f^{-1}$ does not mean $1/f$.

concepts.title: 用相邻幂估计对数
concepts.summary: 当 $c>1$，$c^a<x<c^b$ 推出 $a<\log_cx<b$。通过中间指数与连续开平方细化估计。

method.title: 细化并舍入
method.body: 估计中点的幂，反复二分；确认所需小数位的舍入区间。

pitfalls: 对数曲线不呈线性；等距真数通常不对应等距对数。

en.title: Estimate a logarithm using powers
en.summary: For $c>1$, $c^a<x<c^b$ implies $a<\log_cx<b$. Refine using intermediate exponents and successive square roots.

method.title: Refine and round
method.body: Estimate a midpoint power, bisect again, and check the interval for the required rounding.

pitfalls: A logarithm is not linear; equally spaced arguments do not generally have equally spaced logarithms.

concepts.title: 对数尺度与增长反问题

method.title: 转换模型
method.body: 由对数值求原量时改写为指数形式；比较时先写两个原量，再相除。

method.title: 检查情境
method.body: 对数的真数是无量纲比值。时间问题检查起点、整数天数及严格超过的条件。

pitfalls: 本节地震模型比较的是振幅；不要把振幅比称作能量比。

en.title: Logarithmic scales and inverse growth models
en.summary: If $M=\log(A/A_0)$, then $A=A_0\,10^M$. Two amplitudes have ratio $10^{M_1-M_2}$, with $A,A_0>0$.

method.title: Invert the model
method.body: Convert a logarithmic scale reading to exponential form. For comparison, write each original quantity and divide.

method.title: Check the context
method.body: A logarithm receives a dimensionless ratio. For time models, check the time origin, whole days, and strict exceedance.

pitfalls: The earthquake model compares amplitudes; an amplitude ratio is not an energy ratio.

concepts.title: 自然对数与螺线
concepts.summary: $e\approx2.718281828$，$\ln x=\log_e x$ 是 $e^x$ 的反函数。螺线 $r=e^{0.14\theta}$ 等价于 $\ln r=0.14\theta$（$r>0$，$\theta$ 为弧度）。

method.title: 理解自然对数
method.body: 交换 $y=e^x$ 的变量得到 $y=\ln x$，图像特征与其他合法底数的对数相同。

method.title: 求螺线参数
method.body: 已知角代入指数式；已知距离时用 $\theta=\ln r/0.14$。

pitfalls: 近似 e 的大指数表达式需要足够数值精度；九位小数应按四舍五入判断。

en.title: Natural logarithms and a spiral
en.summary: $e\approx2.718281828$ and $\ln x=\log_e x$ is the inverse of $e^x$. The spiral $r=e^{0.14\theta}$ is equivalent to $\ln r=0.14\theta$, with $r>0$ and $\theta$ in radians.

method.title: Interpret the natural logarithm
method.body: Swap the variables of $y=e^x$ to obtain $y=\ln x$, with the standard logarithmic graph characteristics.

method.title: Determine spiral parameters
method.body: Substitute a known angle in the exponential form; for a known distance use $\theta=\ln r/0.14$.

pitfalls: Large-power approximations of e require sufficient numerical precision; compare rounded values at nine decimal places.

questions.prompt: 用计算器求各式中指数 $x$ 的近似值，保留一位小数：(a) $10^x=0.5$；(b) $10^x=4$；(c) $10^x=8$。

en.prompt: Use a calculator to determine the decimal approximation of the exponent $x$ in each equation, to one decimal place: (a) $10^x=0.5$; (b) $10^x=4$; (c) $10^x=8$.

steps.title: Round and check
steps.body: To one decimal place the exponents are $-0.3,0.6,0.9$. Substitution gives $10^{-0.3}\approx0.501$, $10^{0.6}\approx3.981$, and $10^{0.9}\approx7.943$.

en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 探究 1

questions.prompt: (a) 完成 $y=10^x$ 的表并画图。六列分别给出 $x=-1,\square,0,\square,\square,1$ 及 $y=\square,0.5,\square,4,8,\square$。(b) 写出 (i) 定义域、(ii) 值域、(iii) 横轴截点、(iv) 纵轴截点、(v) 渐近线方程。

steps.title: (b) 读出特征
steps.body: (i) 任意实数指数均有定义，定义域 $\mathbb R$。(ii) $10^x>0$，值域 $(0,\infty)$。(iii) 永不等于零，无横轴截点。(iv) $10^0=1$，纵轴截点 $(0,1)$。(v) $x\to-\infty$ 时 $10^x\to0^+$，水平渐近线 $y=0$。

questions.answer: 定义域 $\mathbb R$；值域 $(0,\infty)$；无横轴截点；纵轴截点 $(0,1)$；渐近线 $y=0$。

en.prompt: (a) Complete the table for $y=10^x$, then graph the function. The six columns give $x=-1,\square,0,\square,\square,1$ and $y=\square,0.5,\square,4,8,\square$. (b) Identify (i) domain, (ii) range, (iii) x-intercept, (iv) y-intercept, and (v) asymptote equations.

steps.title: (a) Complete the table and graph
steps.body: The completed points are $(-1,0.1)$, $(-0.30103,0.5)$, $(0,1)$, $(0.60206,4)$, $(0.90309,8)$, and $(1,10)$. Plot using unrounded exponents and join smoothly; the blue solution curve is $10^x$.

steps.title: (b) Determine characteristics
steps.body: (i) Every real exponent is allowed: domain $\mathbb R$. (ii) $10^x>0$: range $(0,\infty)$. (iii) It never equals zero: no x-intercept. (iv) $10^0=1$: y-intercept $(0,1)$. (v) As $x\to-\infty$, $10^x\to0^+$: horizontal asymptote $y=0$.

en.answer: Domain $\mathbb R$; range $(0,\infty)$; no x-intercept; y-intercept $(0,1)$; asymptote $y=0$.
en.label: Investigate 2

questions.label: 探究 2

questions.prompt: (a) 完成 $y=10^x$ 的反函数 $x=10^y$ 的表并画图。六列给出 $x=\square,0.5,\square,4,8,\square$ 及 $y=-1,\square,0,\square,\square,1$。(b) 写出 (i) 定义域、(ii) 值域、(iii) 横轴截点、(iv) 纵轴截点、(v) 渐近线。

steps.title: (b) 确定五项特征
steps.body: (i) 因 $x=10^y>0$，定义域 $(0,\infty)$。(ii) 任意实数 $y$ 均可，值域 $\mathbb R$。(iii) $y=0\Rightarrow x=1$，横轴截点 $(1,0)$。(iv) $x=0$ 不在定义域，无纵轴截点。(v) $x\to0^+$ 时 $y\to-\infty$，竖直渐近线 $x=0$。

questions.answer: $y=\log x$；定义域 $(0,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$，横轴截点 $(1,0)$，无纵轴截点，渐近线 $x=0$。

en.prompt: (a) Complete the table for $x=10^y$, the inverse of $y=10^x$, then draw the inverse. The columns give $x=\square,0.5,\square,4,8,\square$ and $y=-1,\square,0,\square,\square,1$. (b) Identify (i) domain, (ii) range, (iii) x-intercept, (iv) y-intercept, and (v) asymptote.

steps.title: (a) Swap coordinates
steps.body: The points are $(0.1,-1)$, $(0.5,-0.30103)$, $(1,0)$, $(4,0.60206)$, $(8,0.90309)$, and $(10,1)$. Join them as the smooth curve $y=\log x$, shown in red.

steps.title: (b) Determine the five characteristics
steps.body: (i) Since $x=10^y>0$, domain $(0,\infty)$. (ii) Every real $y$ is possible: range $\mathbb R$. (iii) $y=0\Rightarrow x=1$: x-intercept $(1,0)$. (iv) $x=0$ is outside the domain: no y-intercept. (v) As $x\to0^+$, $y\to-\infty$: vertical asymptote $x=0$.

en.answer: $y=\log x$; domain $(0,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, x-intercept $(1,0)$, no y-intercept, asymptote $x=0$.
en.label: Investigate 3

questions.label: 探究 3

questions.prompt: 用计算器 log 键求近似值，保留三位小数：(a) $\log0.5$；(b) $\log4$；(c) $\log8$。你发现了什么？

steps.title: 解释观察
steps.body: 这些是探究 1 中 $10^x=0.5,4,8$ 的指数，也是在反函数表中对应 $x=0.5,4,8$ 的纵坐标。因为 $\log a$ 正是使 $10^x=a$ 的指数。

en.prompt: Use the log function on a calculator to find each decimal approximation to three decimal places: (a) $\log0.5$; (b) $\log4$; (c) $\log8$. What do you notice about these values?

steps.title: Explain the observation
steps.body: These are the exponents from Investigate 1 and the inverse-table y-values for inputs $0.5,4,8$. The value $\log a$ is precisely the exponent satisfying $10^x=a$.

en.answer: (a) $-0.301$; (b) $0.602$; (c) $0.903$; they are the corresponding base-ten exponents.
en.label: Investigate 4

questions.label: 探究 4

questions.prompt: 说明指数函数 $y=10^x$ 的图像与反函数图像之间的关系。

steps.title: 识别对称线
steps.body: 坐标交换是关于直线 $y=x$ 的反射，所以两图关于 $y=x$ 对称。

en.prompt: Explain how the graph of the exponential function $y=10^x$ and its inverse graph are related.

steps.title: Exchange input and output
steps.body: If $(a,10^a)$ lies on the exponential graph, $(10^a,a)$ lies on its inverse; for example, $(0,1)$ corresponds to $(1,0)$.

steps.title: Identify the reflection line
steps.body: Swapping coordinates reflects a point across $y=x$, so the two graphs are reflections in that line.

en.answer: The graphs reflect in the line $y=x$.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 5

questions.label: 反思与回应 5

questions.prompt: 反函数图像是否表示一个函数？说明理由。

steps.title: 检查唯一输出
steps.body: $10^y$ 随 $y$ 严格递增，因此对于每一个 $x>0$，方程 $x=10^y$ 恰有一个实数 $y$。

steps.title: 用图像检验
steps.body: 每条竖直线与反函数图最多相交一次，所以通过竖线检验。

questions.answer: 是；每个正输入恰有一个输出。

en.prompt: Does the inverse graph represent a function? Explain.

steps.title: Check output uniqueness
steps.body: $10^y$ is strictly increasing, so each $x>0$ corresponds to exactly one real $y$ satisfying $x=10^y$.

steps.title: Apply the vertical-line test
steps.body: Every vertical line meets the inverse graph at most once, so it passes the vertical-line test.

en.answer: Yes; every positive input has exactly one output.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 6

questions.label: 反思与回应 6

questions.prompt: 反函数图上的点形如 $(x,\log x)$。解释 $\log x$ 的含义。

steps.title: 解释纵坐标
steps.body: 令 $y=\log x$，则 $10^y=x$。所以 $\log x$ 是把 10 乘方得到 $x$ 所需的指数；必须有 $x>0$。

en.prompt: Points on the inverse graph are of the form $(x,\log x)$. Explain the meaning of $\log x$.

steps.title: Interpret the y-coordinate
steps.body: Let $y=\log x$; then $10^y=x$. Thus $\log x$ is the exponent to which ten must be raised to produce $x$, requiring $x>0$.

en.answer: $\log x$ is the exponent $y$ for which $10^y=x$.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 7

questions.label: 反思与回应 7

en.prompt: Evaluate: (a) $\log_7 49$; (b) $\log_6 1$; (c) $\log0.001$; (d) $\log_2\sqrt8$.

steps.title: (d) Use a rational exponent
steps.body: $\sqrt8=(2^3)^{1/2}=2^{3/2}$, so $\log_2\sqrt8=3/2$. All arguments are positive and all bases are legal.

en.label: Example 1

questions.prompt: 任何真数为 $1$ 的对数值是多少？为什么？

steps.title: 使用零次幂
steps.body: 对任何合法底数 $c>0,c\ne1$，$c^0=1$。由定义 $\log_c1=0$。

en.prompt: What is the value of any logarithm with an argument of $1$? Why?

steps.title: Use the zero power
steps.body: For every legal base $c>0,c\ne1$, $c^0=1$. Therefore $\log_c1=0$ by definition.

en.answer: $0$, because $c^0=1$.
en.label: Margin: argument one

questions.label: 旁注：真数为 1

steps.title: (d) Combine powers of three
steps.body: $9\sqrt3=3^2\cdot3^{1/2}=3^{5/2}$, so the value is $5/2$. Every argument is strictly positive.

questions.prompt: 为什么底数须满足 $c>0$ 且 $c\ne1$？

steps.title: 排除不适用的指数函数
steps.body: $c=0$ 时负指数如 $0^{-1}$ 无定义；$c<0$ 时如 $(-2)^{1/2}$ 不是实数，不能对所有实指数定义实值指数函数。

steps.title: 排除非一一对应
steps.body: $c=1$ 时 $1^y=1$ 对所有 $y$ 成立，无法由真数 1 确定唯一指数；其他正真数又无解。其余正底数产生一一对应的指数函数，才有对数反函数。

questions.answer: 需要 $c>0,c\ne1$，以获得全实数指数上的实值、一一对应函数。

en.prompt: Why does $c$ have the restrictions $c>0$ and $c\ne1$?

steps.title: Exclude unsuitable exponential functions
steps.body: If $c=0$, a negative power such as $0^{-1}$ is undefined. If $c<0$, a value such as $(-2)^{1/2}$ is not real, preventing a real exponential function on all real inputs.

steps.title: Exclude a constant function
steps.body: For $c=1$, $1^y=1$ for every $y$, so argument one has no unique exponent and every other positive argument has none. A positive base other than one gives a one-to-one exponential function and hence a logarithmic inverse.

en.answer: $c>0,c\ne1$ gives a real, one-to-one exponential function on all real exponents.
en.label: Margin: restrictions on the base

questions.label: 旁注：底数限制

steps.title: (b) 检查底数
steps.body: $x^2=36$ 给出 $x=\pm6$。底数必须正且不为 1，故只保留 $x=6$；$6^2=36$ 验证原式。

steps.title: (a) Convert and evaluate
steps.body: $x=5^{-3}=1/125>0$, so the original logarithm is defined and equals $-3$.

steps.title: (b) Check the base
steps.body: $x^2=36$ gives $x=\pm6$. A logarithm base must be positive and unequal to one, so only $x=6$ remains; $6^2=36$ checks the original equation.

questions.prompt: (a) 写出 $f(x)=3^x$ 的反函数。(b) 画反函数图，写出其定义域、值域、横轴截点、纵轴截点及渐近线方程。

steps.title: (b) 特征
steps.body: 因 $3^y>0$，定义域 $(0,\infty)$；任何实数 $y$ 均可，值域 $\mathbb R$。$\log_3 1=0$，横轴截点 $(1,0)$；$x=0$ 被排除，无纵轴截点。竖直渐近线 $x=0$，没有水平渐近线。

questions.answer: $f^{-1}(x)=\log_3x$；定义域 $(0,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$，横轴截点 $(1,0)$，无纵轴截点；渐近线 $x=0$。

en.prompt: (a) State the inverse of $f(x)=3^x$. (b) Sketch its graph and identify the inverse domain and range, x-intercept, y-intercept, and any asymptote equations.

steps.title: (b) Plot exact points
steps.body: Swap $(-2,1/9),(-1,1/3),(0,1),(1,3),(2,9)$ to obtain $(1/9,-2),(1/3,-1),(1,0),(3,1),(9,2)$. The inverse is increasing and reflects the exponential graph in $y=x$.

steps.title: (b) Characteristics
steps.body: Since $3^y>0$, domain $(0,\infty)$; every real $y$ occurs, giving range $\mathbb R$. Since $\log_3 1=0$, the x-intercept is $(1,0)$; $x=0$ is excluded, so there is no y-intercept. The vertical asymptote is $x=0$; there is no horizontal asymptote.

en.answer: $f^{-1}(x)=\log_3x$; domain $(0,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, x-intercept $(1,0)$, no y-intercept; asymptote $x=0$.
en.label: Example 3

questions.label: 例题 3

questions.prompt: 如何判断 $y=\log_3x$ 是一个函数？

steps.title: 由一一对应判断
steps.body: $3^x$ 严格递增，任意水平线最多交一次；其反射图通过竖线检验。每个 $x>0$ 恰有一个指数 $y$ 满足 $3^y=x$。

questions.answer: 每个正输入都有唯一输出，因此是函数。

en.prompt: How do you know that $y=\log_3x$ is a function?

steps.title: Use the one-to-one property
steps.body: $3^x$ is strictly increasing and passes the horizontal-line test. Its reflection passes the vertical-line test: each $x>0$ has exactly one exponent $y$ satisfying $3^y=x$.

en.answer: Every positive input has a unique output, so it is a function.
en.label: Margin: why a function

questions.label: 旁注：为何是函数

questions.prompt: $f(x)=3^x$ 与 $f^{-1}(x)=\log_3x$ 的 $x,y$ 值如何对应？说明。

steps.title: 对应点互换坐标
steps.body: $3^1=3$，所以 $(1,3)$ 在原图，$(3,1)$ 在反函数图；一般 $(a,b)$ 变为 $(b,a)$。这是交换输入和输出。

en.prompt: How are the values of $x$ and $y$ related in the functions $f(x)=3^x$ and $f^{-1}(x)=\log_3x$? Explain.

steps.title: Corresponding points swap coordinates
steps.body: $3^1=3$, so $(1,3)$ belongs to the original and $(3,1)$ to the inverse. In general, $(a,b)$ becomes $(b,a)$, exchanging input and output.

en.answer: Corresponding x- and y-coordinates exchange roles.
en.label: Margin: coordinate relationship

questions.label: 旁注：坐标关系

questions.prompt: $f^{-1}(x)=\log_3x$ 的特征与 $f(x)=3^x$ 有何对应关系？

steps.title: 交换定义域与值域
steps.body: $3^x$ 的定义域 $\mathbb R$、值域 $(0,\infty)$，分别成为对数函数的值域与定义域。二者均递增。

steps.title: 交换轴与截点

en.prompt: The Richter magnitude is $M=\log(A/A_0)$, where $A$ is ground-motion amplitude (usually microns) and $A_0>0$ is the distance-corrected standard amplitude. (a) A 1946 Vancouver Island earthquake had amplitude $10^{7.3}A_0$. Find its magnitude. (b) The 1949 Haida Gwaii earthquake had magnitude $8.1$. How many times $A_0$ was its amplitude? (c) Compare the shaking amplitudes of the 1949 and 1946 earthquakes.

steps.title: (a) Substitute the ratio
steps.body: $M=\log(10^{7.3}A_0/A_0)=\log10^{7.3}=7.3$. The positive amplitude ratio makes the logarithm valid.

steps.title: (b) Recover the amplitude
steps.body: $8.1=\log(A/A_0)\Rightarrow A/A_0=10^{8.1}\approx125\,892\,541$, about $1.26\times10^8$ times the standard amplitude.

steps.title: (c) Compare amplitudes in the same units
steps.body: $A_{1949}/A_{1946}=10^{8.1}A_0/(10^{7.3}A_0)=10^{0.8}\approx6.3$. This is an amplitude ratio, not an energy ratio.

en.answer: (a) $7.3$; (b) about $1.26\times10^8$ times; (c) Haida Gwaii amplitude was about $6.3$ times Vancouver Island amplitude.

exercises.prompt: 实对数底数可为除 1 外的任意正实数。举例说明为什么底数不能是：(a) 0；(b) 1；(c) 负数。

steps.body: 若尝试 $\log_0 2$，需 $0^y=2$，没有实指数解；$0^{-1}$ 又无定义。不能建立正常的指数反函数。

steps.title: (b) 底数 1
steps.body: $\log_1 1$ 需 $1^y=1$，每个实数 $y$ 都成立，输出不唯一；$\log_1 2$ 则无解。

steps.title: (c) 负底数

en.prompt: The base of a logarithm can be any positive real number except one. Use examples to illustrate why it cannot be (a) zero; (b) one; (c) negative.

steps.title: (a) Base zero
steps.body: Attempting $\log_0 2$ requires $0^y=2$, which has no real solution; $0^{-1}$ is also undefined. There is no suitable exponential inverse.

steps.title: (b) Base one
steps.body: $\log_1 1$ requires $1^y=1$, true for every real $y$, so there is no unique output. $\log_1 2$ has no solution.

steps.title: (c) A negative base
steps.body: For example, $(-2)^{1/2}$ is not real, so $(-2)^y$ cannot be the required real exponential function on every real input. Some defined integer powers do not produce the real logarithmic function defined in this section.

exercises.prompt: 巴勒莫撞击危险尺度为 $P=\log R$，$R$ 为相对风险。比较尺度值分别为 $-1.66$ 与 $-4.83$ 的两颗小行星的相对风险。

en.prompt: The Palermo Technical Impact Hazard scale is $P=\log R$, where $R$ is relative risk. Compare the relative risks of two asteroids with Palermo values $-1.66$ and $-4.83$.

steps.title: Recover positive risks
steps.body: $R_1=10^{-1.66}\approx0.02188$ and $R_2=10^{-4.83}\approx0.00001479$. Both are positive; a negative scale value does not mean negative risk.

steps.title: Compare by division
steps.body: $R_1/R_2=10^{-1.66}/10^{-4.83}=10^{3.17}\approx1479$. The asteroid with value $-1.66$ has about $1479$ times the relative risk of the other.

en.answer: The risk for $-1.66$ is about $1479$ times the risk for $-4.83$.

A 1982 earthquake near Big Beaver, Saskatchewan had magnitude $3.9$. How many times as great was the Nahanni shaking amplitude?

en.prompt: If $\log_5x=2$, determine $\log_5(125x)$.

steps.title: Rewrite as a power of five
解联立方程
steps.body: 两式相加 $2m=28\Rightarrow m=14$。再由 $m+n=27$ 得 $n=13$。

en.prompt: If $\log_3(m-n)=0$ and $\log_3(m+n)=3$, determine $m$ and $n$.

steps.title: Solve the simultaneous equations
steps.body: Add to obtain $2m=28\Rightarrow m=14$. Then $m+n=27$ gives $n=13$.

steps.title: Check both arguments
steps.body: $14-13=1>0$ and $14+13=27>0$, giving logarithms zero and three as required.

exercises.prompt: 若 $\log_3m=n$，用 $n$ 表示 $\log_3(m^4)$。

en.prompt: If $\log_3m=n$, determine $\log_3(m^4)$ in terms of $n$.

steps.title: Express m using the definition
steps.body: The original logarithm requires $m>0$ and gives $m=3^n$.

en.answer: $4n$, with $m>0$ required by the original equation.

exercises.prompt: 求 $y=\log_2(\log_3x)$ 的反函数方程。

steps.title: 先确定原定义域
steps.body: 内层需 $x>0$，外层需 $\log_3x>0$。因底数 $3>1$，合起来是 $x>1$。原函数递增，值域为 $\mathbb R$。

steps.title: 核对逆运算与范围
steps.body: 任意实数 $x$ 都有 $2^x>0$，故 $3^{2^x}>1$。代回复合得 $\log_2(\log_3(3^{2^x}))=\log_2(2^x)=x$。反函数定义域 $\mathbb R$，值域 $(1,\infty)$。

en.prompt: Determine the inverse equation of $y=\log_2(\log_3x)$.

steps.title: Determine the original domain
steps.body: The inner logarithm requires $x>0$ and the outer requires $\log_3x>0$. Since $3>1$, together these give $x>1$. The original function increases and has range $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Check composition and range
steps.body: For every real $x$, $2^x>0$, hence $3^{2^x}>1$. Composition gives $\log_2(\log_3(3^{2^x}))=\log_2(2^x)=x$. The inverse domain is $\mathbb R$ and range $(1,\infty)$.

en.answer: $y=3^{2^x}$; domain $\mathbb R$, range $(1,\infty)$.

en.prompt: If $m=\log_2n$ and $2m+1=\log_2(16n)$, determine $m,n$.

steps.title: Compare exponents with a common base
steps.body: Substitute $n=2^m$: $2^{2m+1}=2^4\cdot2^m=2^{m+4}$. The exponential is one-to-one, so $2m+1=m+4$, giving $m=3$ and $n=8$.

exercises.prompt: 画 $y=|\log_2x|$，说明它与 $y=\log_2x$ 图像的关系。

steps.title: 应用绝对值
steps.body: 所以 $y=-\log_2x$（$0<x<1$），$y=\log_2x$（$x\ge1$）。把原图横轴以下部分关于横轴向上反射，其余保持。

en.prompt: Graph $y=|\log_2x|$. Describe how it is related to $y=\log_2x$.

steps.title: Determine the original sign
steps.body: $\log_2x<0$ for $0<x<1$, equals zero at $x=1$, and is positive for $x>1$.

steps.title: Apply the absolute value
steps.body: Thus $y=-\log_2x$ for $0<x<1$ and $y=\log_2x$ for $x\ge1$. Reflect the part below the x-axis upward and retain the rest.

steps.title: Mark points and characteristics
steps.body: The graph passes through $(1/4,2),(1/2,1),(1,0),(2,1),(4,2)$. Domain $(0,\infty)$, range $[0,\infty)$, minimum $(1,0)$, no y-intercept, and vertical asymptote $x=0$.

en.answer: Reflect the negative part upward; the domain is positive inputs and the range is nonnegative outputs.

exercises.prompt: 制作思维导图，总结 $y=\log_cx$（$c>0,c\ne1$）的图像知识，并与同学交流完善。

steps.title: 建立中心与分支
steps.body: 中心为 $y=\log_cx$。第一支“定义”：$c^y=x$，合法底数 $c>0,c\ne1$，真数 $x>0$。第二支“反函数”：$y=c^x$，交换坐标，关于 $y=x$ 对称。

steps.title: 加入图像的固定特征
steps.body: 第三支“范围与轴”：定义域 $(0,\infty)$、值域 $\mathbb R$、横轴截点 $(1,0)$、无纵轴截点、竖直渐近线 $x=0$。第四支“精确点”：$(1/c,-1),(1,0),(c,1)$。

steps.title: 区分两种底数并交流
steps.body: 第五支“增减”：$c>1$ 递增，$x\to0^+$ 时趋于 $-\infty$；$0<c<1$ 递减，$x\to0^+$ 时趋于 $+\infty$。第六支“常用”：$c=10$ 写作 $\log x$。这是一份可核对的示例；与同学实际交流后可补充自己的连接，不能把示例当成已发生的讨论。

exercises.answer: 示例导图含定义、反函数、范围与轴、精确点、两类底数、常用对数六个分支；同伴交流由学生实际完成。

en.prompt: Create a mind map summarizing what you know about $y=\log_cx$, where $c>0,c\ne1$. Enhance it by sharing ideas with classmates.

steps.title: Build the centre and branches
steps.body: Centre the map on $y=\log_cx$. Branch 1, definition: $c^y=x$, with $c>0,c\ne1$ and $x>0$. Branch 2, inverse: $y=c^x$, coordinates swap, reflection in $y=x$.

steps.title: Add invariant graph characteristics
steps.body: Branch 3, domain and axes: domain $(0,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, x-intercept $(1,0)$, no y-intercept, vertical asymptote $x=0$. Branch 4, exact points: $(1/c,-1),(1,0),(c,1)$.

steps.title: Separate the two base cases and discuss
steps.body: Branch 5, direction: increasing for $c>1$, with values tending to $-\infty$ as $x\to0^+$; decreasing for $0<c<1$, tending to $+\infty$ as $x\to0^+$. Branch 6, common logarithm: base ten, written $\log x$. This is a checkable sample map; add connections from an actual class discussion when available.

en.answer: A sample map has six branches: definition, inverse, domain/axes, exact points, base cases, and common logarithms. Peer discussion remains a student activity.

exercises.prompt: 迷你实验。无理数不能写成整数之比 $a/b$（$b\ne0$），其小数既不终止也不循环。与 $\pi$ 一样，$e$ 也是无理数；它的出现与约翰·纳皮尔的对数研究有关，莱昂哈德·欧拉研究并采用字母 $e$ 表示它。步骤 1：(a) 用计算器 $e$ 或 $e^x$ 键求 $e$，保留九位小数。(b) 表中 $(1+1/x)^x$ 对 $x=10,100,1000,10000$ 的值为 $2.593742460,2.704813829,2.716923932,2.718145927$。若 $x$ 为 10 的幂，使近似值按九位小数正确舍入的最小 $x$ 是多少？步骤 2：(a) 画 $y=e^x$ 的反函数并给出定义域、值域、横轴截点、纵轴截点及渐近线。(b) 底数为 $e$ 的对数称为自然对数，记为 $\log_ex=\ln x$，写出 $y=e^x$ 的反函数。步骤 3：鹦鹉螺壳呈对数螺线；教材还列举了野羊角、象牙曲线、鹰的进击路径和旋涡星系的旋臂。从 $P(1,0)$ 逆时针转动 $\theta$ 弧度，点至原点距离始终为 $r=e^{0.14\theta}$。(a) 转过 $2\pi$ 时求 $r$，保留两位小数。(b.i) 改写为对数形式。(b.ii) 当 $r=12$ 时求 $\theta$，用弧度表示并保留两位小数。

steps.title: 2(b) 命名反函数
steps.body: $x=e^y\Leftrightarrow y=\log_ex=\ln x$，所以反函数为 $y=\ln x$（$x>0$）。

steps.title: 3(b.ii) 解角度并检查
steps.body: $\theta=\ln12/0.14\approx17.749333$，故 $\theta\approx17.75$ 弧度。代入未舍入值可得 $e^{0.14\theta}=12$；角度从起点累计而不局限于一周。

exercises.answer: 1(a) $2.718281828$；1(b) $10^{10}$。2：$y=\ln x$，定义域 $(0,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$，横轴截点 $(1,0)$，无纵轴截点，渐近线 $x=0$。3(a) $r\approx2.41$；3(b.i) $\ln r=0.14\theta$；3(b.ii) $\theta\approx17.75$ 弧度。

en.prompt: MINI LAB. An irrational number cannot be written as $a/b$ for integers $a,b$ with $b\ne0$, and its decimal neither terminates nor repeats. Like $\pi$, $e$ is irrational. Its emergence is associated with John Napier’s logarithms; Leonhard Euler studied it and introduced the letter $e$. Step 1: (a) Use the $e$ or $e^x$ calculator key to find $e$ to nine decimal places. (b) The table for $(1+1/x)^x$ gives $x=10,100,1000,10000$ and $2.593742460,2.704813829,2.716923932,2.718145927$. As a power of ten, what is the minimum $x$ approximating $e$ correctly to nine decimal places? Step 2: (a) Graph the inverse of $y=e^x$ and identify its domain, range, x-intercept, y-intercept, and asymptote. (b) A base-$e$ logarithm is a natural logarithm, $\log_ex=\ln x$. What is the inverse of $y=e^x$? Step 3: A chambered nautilus shell has a logarithmic spiral; the textbook also describes sheep horns, elephant tusks, a hawk’s approach, and spiral-galaxy arms as examples. Starting from $P(1,0)$, rotate counterclockwise by $\theta$ radians with distance $r=e^{0.14\theta}$ from the origin. (a) Find $r$ after $2\pi$ radians, to two decimals. (b.i) Write the relation in logarithmic form. (b.ii) Find $\theta$ for $r=12$, in radians to two decimals.

steps.title: 1(a) Euler’s number
steps.body: $e=2.718281828459\ldots$, which rounds to $2.718281828$ to nine decimal places.

steps.title: 1(b) Test adjacent powers of ten
steps.body: With sufficient precision, $x=10^8$ gives $2.718281814867\ldots\to2.718281815$; $x=10^9$ gives $2.718281827099\ldots\to2.718281827$; $x=10^{10}$ gives $2.718281828323\ldots\to2.718281828$. The expression increases toward $e$ as positive $x$ increases, so every smaller power of ten also fails; the minimum is $10^{10}$. Use sufficient precision to avoid rounding error in $1+1/x$ for large $x$.

steps.title: 2(a) Graph and five characteristics
steps.body: Swap $(-1,1/e),(0,1),(1,e)$ to $(1/e,-1),(1,0),(e,1)$ and draw an increasing smooth curve. Domain $(0,\infty)$; range $\mathbb R$; x-intercept $(1,0)$; no y-intercept; vertical asymptote $x=0$.

steps.title: 2(b) Name the inverse
steps.body: $x=e^y\Leftrightarrow y=\log_ex=\ln x$, so the inverse is $y=\ln x$ for $x>0$.

steps.title: 3(a) Substitute one full turn in radians
steps.body: $r=e^{0.14(2\pi)}=e^{0.28\pi}\approx2.410046$, so the distance is about $2.41$ coordinate units.

steps.title: 3(b.i) Convert forms
steps.body: $r=e^{0.14\theta}\Leftrightarrow\log_er=0.14\theta$, or $\ln r=0.14\theta$. The exponential form guarantees $r>0$.

steps.title: 3(b.ii) Solve and check the angle
steps.body: $\theta=\ln12/0.14\approx17.749333$, hence $\theta\approx17.75$ radians. Substitution of the unrounded value gives $e^{0.14\theta}=12$. This is accumulated rotation from the start, not restricted to one revolution.

en.answer: 1(a) $2.718281828$; 1(b) $10^{10}$. 2: $y=\ln x$, domain $(0,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, x-intercept $(1,0)$, no y-intercept, asymptote $x=0$. 3(a) $r\approx2.41$; 3(b.i) $\ln r=0.14\theta$; 3(b.ii) $\theta\approx17.75$ radians.
